title.rendered: Labour Colony in West Delhi — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Construction sites across West Delhi need on-site worker housing that goes up fast and holds up through the project. If you are setting up a labour colony in West Delhi for crews working around Janakpuri, Dwarka or Rajouri Garden, SAMAN Portable supplies prefabricated worker accommodation built on an IS 2062 MS frame with insulated panels. As a direct manufacturer serving India since 2009 (incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019), we fabricate to your capacity and dispatch units to NCR sites from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory.

SAMAN manufactures and dispatches labour colony units directly from our Greater Noida facility (Jalpura, PIN 201308) — factory-to-site delivery across Delhi NCR without middlemen. West Delhi sites — across the Mundka, Nangloi and Kirti Nagar industrial belts — are a direct NCR dispatch from the same plant.

As a direct manufacturer — serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019 (POS = Portable Office Solutions) — we build to IS 2062 structural steel under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001 systems, with 500+ projects delivered across India and NSIC and DPIIT recognition. Our portable labour hutments carry a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

Why Worker Housing Matters for West Delhi Projects

West Delhi runs multiple construction fronts at once — Metro work near Janakpuri, road and expressway upgrades around Dwarka, and commercial redevelopment in Rajouri Garden. Housing workers properly on or near site is not just convenience; it keeps crews available, reduces daily commute loss and helps you meet labour-welfare expectations for temporary worker accommodation.

Risks of Poor Worker Housing

  • Crew absenteeism from long daily commutes
  • Higher turnover that slips project timelines
  • Safety gaps from makeshift rest facilities
  • Compliance pressure on informal settlements
  • Neighbourhood complaints in dense urban zones

Benefits of a Planned Labour Colony

  • Better retention and on-site productivity
  • Lower transport and logistics overhead
  • Cleaner compliance footing for worker welfare
  • A more credible site for client walkthroughs
  • Faster mobilisation when phases ramp up

Common Issues Contractors Face Setting Up Site Housing

Worker housing in West Delhi comes with constraints you don't always hit on greenfield sites. Knowing them up front lets us design the colony around your actual plot and timeline.

Compliance Documentation

Temporary worker housing in Delhi has to align with labour-welfare and pollution-control expectations. We design the colony to support those requirements and supply the unit specifications you need for documentation.

Quality Concerns

Tin sheds and makeshift accommodation create heat, damp and fire risk. Panel-built units with insulated walls give workers a far safer, more liveable rest space on site.

Space Constraints

West Delhi plots are tight. We optimise layout — single or double floor, linear or cluster — to fit maximum capacity into the footprint you have available.

Planning Worker Housing for a West Delhi Site?

Tell us your worker count, plot size and timeline. We can supply and install a labour colony across West Delhi's construction corridors.

Call +91 62009 09435 Send Enquiry

How SAMAN's Labour Colonies Solve These Issues

SAMAN Portable manufactures prefabricated labour colony units that are built off-site, transported, and assembled on your West Delhi plot. The approach pairs quick on-site installation with a proper insulated, IS 2062 MS-frame structure rather than improvised tin.

Tin Sheds vs. Insulated Panel Colonies

Feature Traditional Tin Sheds SAMAN Panel Colonies
Wall build Single-skin metal sheet Insulated panel on IS 2062 MS frame
Temperature control Poor — hot in summer, cold in winter Insulated panels regulate indoor temperature
Durability Short-life, frequent repairs 5-yr structural frame warranty; 20–25-yr service life
Fire safety High risk Fire-retardant panel options
Electrical Aftermarket, often unsafe Pre-wired points fitted in the unit

Key Advantages

  • Factory-built quality: Units fabricated to IS 2062 standards under ISO 9001:2015 processes
  • Scalable capacity: Configure from small crews up to large multi-block colonies
  • Relocatable: Move the colony to your next site when the project moves
  • Turnkey supply: Sanitation, common areas and amenity blocks specified to your needs
  • Backed warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing

Factory-direct dispatch: Every NCR labour colony is fabricated and shipped from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory — a short, direct route into West Delhi sites rather than a distant supplier handoff.

Technical Build: Quality Construction for Worker Comfort

SAMAN's labour accommodation for West Delhi is built with materials chosen for durability, thermal comfort and safety, so the structure earns its place across a long project rather than needing constant patching.

Insulated Panel Construction

  • ~50–60mm insulated (PUF/foam-core) wall and roof panels
  • Better indoor temperature control year-round
  • Sound dampening for quieter rest
  • Water-resistant, easy-to-clean surfaces
  • Fire-retardant panel options

Structural Integrity

  • IS 2062 MS-frame structure with anti-corrosion coating
  • Stable base suitable for temporary or semi-permanent siting
  • MS railings and staircases for multi-floor setups
  • Engineered to handle typical NCR site wind loads
  • 5-yr structural frame and base warranty

Utility Systems

  • Pre-wired electrical points with safety fittings
  • Ventilation designed for air circulation
  • Plumbing-ready for attached toilet options
  • Provision for centralised water storage
  • Roof suitable for optional solar add-on

Want the full technical specification?

Send us your capacity and amenity requirements and we'll quote a labour colony built to IS 2062 with insulated panels.

Call +91 62009 09435 Send Enquiry

Janakpuri, Dwarka & Rajouri Garden — West Delhi Service Zones

We can supply and install labour colonies across West Delhi's active construction corridors. Janakpuri, Dwarka and Rajouri Garden are typical zones where contractors need on-site worker housing close to the work.

Janakpuri

For Metro-corridor and residential construction around Janakpuri, we can configure colonies that fit tight urban plots while keeping security and access practical for the crew.

Typical work: Metro-related, commercial complexes, residential towers

Dwarka

Dwarka sites near NH-48 and the wider sub-city development zone need space-efficient housing. We optimise the layout to maximise capacity without losing amenities.

Typical work: Road works, sub-city construction, commercial hubs

Rajouri Garden

For commercial redevelopment around Rajouri Garden, we supply colonies with proper common areas, built to last across longer project durations.

Typical work: Mall and office redevelopment, urban renewal

Customisation: Tailored to Your Project Needs

Every site has different worker numbers, plot shapes and amenity needs. Our labour colony in West Delhi can be configured around your specific project — from capacity to layout to facilities.

Structural Options

  • Single or Double Floor: Add capacity vertically on tight plots
  • Worker Modules: Room sizing scaled to your crew count
  • Layout Design: Linear, cluster or courtyard arrangements
  • Base Type: Temporary or semi-permanent by project duration
  • Security Features: Fencing, controlled access, guard block

Amenity Options

  • Toilets: Shared or attached sanitation blocks
  • Kitchen & Dining: Communal or per-block cooking spaces
  • Rest Areas: Shaded off-duty spaces
  • Storage: Secure personal-belongings storage
  • Supervisor Block: Quarters and site-admin space

Compliance Support and Site Fitment

Worker housing in West Delhi has to align with local labour-welfare and pollution-control expectations. SAMAN Portable builds the colony to support those requirements and helps you with site preparation and the unit specifications needed for documentation.

What the Build Supports

  • Pollution-control expectations for temporary structures
  • Building and Other Construction Workers welfare provisions
  • Fire safety considerations for site housing
  • Electrical safety fittings for worker rooms
  • Sanitation and waste-handling layout

Site Fitment Services

  • Site Survey: Assessment of plot, access and utilities
  • Drainage Planning: Water-management layout
  • Electrical Layout: Safe power-distribution planning
  • Base Preparation: Levelling and base work guidance
  • Spec Documentation: Unit specifications for your records

Our Simple 4-Step Process

Getting a labour colony in West Delhi set up with SAMAN Portable is straightforward, with each stage planned to keep disruption to your site low.

  1. Consultation & Site Assessment

    We discuss your worker count, plot and timeline, and assess access, utility points and site constraints specific to your West Delhi location.

  2. Customised Design & Proposal

    We prepare a layout that fits your footprint and capacity, with detailed specifications, a delivery timeline and a clear quote.

  3. Manufacturing & Installation

    Units are fabricated at our Jalpura, Greater Noida factory, dispatched to your site, and assembled by our installation team.

  4. Handover & Support

    We walk the finished colony with you, confirm systems are working, and remain available for support. Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

FAQs: Labour Colony in West Delhi


How fast can a labour colony be installed in West Delhi?

Lead time depends on capacity and customisation. Because units are prefabricated at our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory and dispatched directly into NCR, installation on a prepared West Delhi site is efficient. Share your worker count and timeline and we'll confirm a schedule with your quote.


What does a labour colony in West Delhi cost?

Pricing is quote-based because it depends on worker capacity, number of floors, amenity blocks (toilets, kitchen, supervisor quarters) and site conditions. Send your requirements through the enquiry form or call +91 62009 09435 for a price on request.


What is the structure made of?

The frame is built to the IS 2062 mild-steel standard with an anti-corrosion coating, clad in ~50–60mm insulated (PUF/foam-core) wall and roof panels for thermal comfort. Units are manufactured under ISO 9001:2015 processes.


What warranty does the labour colony carry?

Our labour colonies carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing, with a 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years figure is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Can the colony be customised and expanded later?

Yes. The modular, panel-built design lets you configure capacity, floors, layout and amenities up front, and add or reconfigure blocks as your workforce changes through the project. It can also be relocated to your next site.


Does SAMAN deliver to all parts of West Delhi?

We supply and install across West Delhi's construction corridors, including Janakpuri, Dwarka and Rajouri Garden, served from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory. Share your site address and we'll confirm delivery in your quote.

Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel labour colony units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida).
